## Legend

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `IDLE` | No task in flight. Safe to submit a new one. |
| `PLANNING` | GPT Architect is turning the task into a spec. |
| `IMPLEMENTING` | Claude Code is editing files inside ai-runner's isolated workspace. |
| `TESTING` | ai-runner is running `npm test` on the staged changes. |
| `WAITING_REVIEW` | PR opened, GPT Reviewer is deciding. |
| `CHANGES_REQUIRED` | Reviewer sent feedback; a new attempt is starting. |
| `APPROVED` | Reviewer approved; awaiting deploy gate (or `DONE` if no deploy). |
| `DEPLOYING` | Railway deploy in progress. |
| `DONE` | Complete. See PR for diff. |
| `FAILED` | Uncaught runner error. Human should inspect the latest `executions/*.json`. |
| `BLOCKED` | Retry cap reached or manual intervention needed. See `error` field. |
